name: Metroidvania
description: Traversal compounded into a world: explore, hit a gate that names the power you lack, come back with it, and watch the map color in behind you. The pack's spine is three cooperating components — the map graph owns topology, power-up grant owns capability mutation, and the ability gate checks one against the other — so lock-and-key design is data all the way down. Platformer and puzzle components carry the moment-to-moment movement; save system and minimap make the world durable and legible.
loop: explore → hit ability gate → backtrack with new power → unlock region

signatureCompound.name: Gate and Backtrack
signatureCompound.description: The genre in miniature: the player reaches a high-ledge gate, is rejected with the missing power named, finds the double-jump grant elsewhere in the graph, and returns to pass — the map revealing each room as it is first visited. If this loop works, every larger metroidvania is repetition and variation of it.
